text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Found you! You're going down, monster!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でたなー！
　
お前なんかやっつけてやるー！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
I've got Misogi and {0} with me...
I'm not scared of anything! Let's go, Misogi!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミソギもこの人もいる……
怖くなんてないもん！　
行こう、ミソギ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's show 'em what a great team we are!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！
　
ミソギたちのコンビネーション、
見せてあげる！
